subject: NovusAI trial: environment comparison, sprint plan & owner commitments
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@novusai.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: samir@novusai.com
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Thanks for a productive call earlier — Samir (Head of ML) and I did a quick internal recap. Two quick asks as we evaluate Redwood: 1) a concise comparison of what NovusAI would lose/gain across the three hosting modes (hosted API, dedicated sandbox, VPC/private) specifically for our use case (PII redaction, latency SLA, and bulk batch embedding throughput) and 2) a proposed 2-week sprint-style evaluation plan with clear pass/fail criteria so our product and infra leads can greenlight next steps.

We'd prefer a hosted trial if we can meet our compliance gating (audit logs + customer-managed KMS), otherwise we'll need to look at dedicated or VPC.

Can you send a one-pager matrix + a short schedule by Friday? Also attach a sample prompt set and the evaluation harness you'd recommend.

Elena
---
Elena Park
Director of Product
NovusAI
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novusai.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Elena — thanks for outlining the asks. Attached is an initial environment-comparison matrix and a compact 2-week sprint plan (see env-comparison-matrix.xlsx). High-level summary below and next steps.

Summary (short):
- Hosted API: fastest to ship, lower ops friction. Meets latency targets for single-request SLAs under 250ms p50 for our recommended model family, but requires KMS integrations we can support via our private key wrapping (we can enable customer-managed keys for auditable logs). Not ideal for bulk offline embedding runs at scale unless paired with burst/dedicated pools.
- Dedicated sandbox: reserved GPU capacity for your tenant. Predictable throughput for batch embeddings and will meet sustained throughput targets. Offers stronger isolation and configurable autoscale. Slightly longer lead time (3-5 business days for sandbox provisioning).
- VPC/private deployment: full network control, best for strict compliance. Longer setup (2-4 weeks depending on infra), likely the path if your Security team needs in-network egress controls and air-gapped data paths.

Pass/fail for two-week sprint (recommended):
- Functional: core endpoint responds and returns structured outputs for our agreed prompt set (pass if >= 98% green tests)
- Latency: median generation latency <= 300ms for 512-token sequences on the hosted path; if dedicated, throughput test of 100 concurrent streams at target latency with <5% error rate
- Data controls: audit log capture enabled and sample log accessible to NovusOps within 48h (pass if logs show request/response IDs and masking flags)
- Embedding throughput: sustained 100k tokens/hr for batch embed job on dedicated (or equivalent using hosted + burst)

Owners and immediate next steps:
- Redwood (Aditya): share one-pager matrix and sprint plan (attached), prep short provisioning checklist for dedicated sandbox.
- Redwood (Ben): coordinate sandbox capacity options and give estimated costs for 2-week reserved sandbox.
- NovusAI (Elena): confirm final list of evaluation prompts and any compliance questionnaire items to prioritize.

I put a draft harness (novusai-mvp-eval-prompts.json) in the Drive link; Ben and Marissa will follow up on capacity and pricing.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: env-comparison-matrix.xlsx, novusai-mvp-eval-prompts.json
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@novusai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Elena — quick note on capacity/costs. For the two-week sprint I recommend two options:

Option A (Fast path - Hosted + burst):
- Use Hosted API with burstable dedicated pool for peak batch runs. Low lead time, nominal infra changes. Estimated incremental cost for 2 weeks: ~$18k.
- Pros: rapid start, minimal infra changes. Cons: less network-level isolation.

Option B (Dedicated sandbox):
- Small reserved T4/Tesla-like pool (3 nodes) for dedicated runs with predictable per-token and embedding throughput. Setup 3-5 business days. Estimated cost for 2 weeks: ~$32k (includes priority scheduling).

If NovusAI needs encryption-in-use or on-prem KMS, that pushes to VPC/private which is a longer engagement; we can provide a scoped estimate once we get infra details.

I'll own provisioning and give a firm start date once Elena confirms which option you prefer.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena@novusai.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: samir@novusai.com, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Thanks — that breakdown is exactly what we needed. Two clarifications before we commit: 1) for "audit log capture": can you show an example log entry with redaction markers (we need to demonstrate to our security lead), and 2) for embedding throughput, can you confirm whether the hosted+burst option will require temporary data export for batch jobs (we prefer in-cloud processing).

We're leaning toward Option A to accelerate internal approvals provided the audit log sample is satisfactory and we can keep the batch ingest within cloud (no vendor export). Can you share the log sample and a one-slide summary of the sandbox provisioning steps (we need to present to procurement Monday).

Elena
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novusai.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Elena — quick deliverables bundle attached and a short schedule. Attachments: env-comparison-matrix.xlsx (updated with redaction example row), novusai-mvp-eval-prompts.json, provisioning-steps-slide.pdf (one-slide checklist).

Quick notes inline: audit-log sample (see matrix tab "log-sample"): we include a redaction flag and request_id, timestamp, and partial-hash. Example row (redacted):
- {"timestamp":"2028-05-12T15:01:23Z","request_id":"req_81f2","redaction_status":"PII_MARKED","masking_map":"user_email=***@novusai.com"} 

Batch processing for embedding using Hosted+burst: runs remain in-cloud; we do not export raw uploads to third-party storage by default. For high-throughput batch jobs we stage data to a temporary encrypted bucket in the cloud region you pick and run jobs against it; bucket lifecycle rules and deletion are configurable and we can show the deletion job in the sprint.

Proposed immediate timeline (if Option A accepted):
- Mon 14 May: finalize prompt set + NDA/PO kickoff (NovusAI)
- Tue 15 May: Redwood enable burst pool and share credentials for sandbox harness
- Wed 16 - Thu 17 May: run functional and latency tests (Aditya)
- Fri 18 May: embedding throughput batch run and logs handoff (Ben + Marissa)
- Mon 21 May: pre-read to procurement/security and go/no-go decision

Please confirm Option A and region choice (us-west-2 preferred) and we'll schedule kickoff.

Thanks,
Aditya

Attachments: provisioning-steps-slide.pdf
